info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Workbench Management API
info.description: The Customer Workbench Management API facilitates the updating and enhancement of customer-related data within the banking system. This API allows authorized users to patch customer workbench entries, ensuring that customer information is current and accurate. It is particularly useful for banking professionals who manage customer interactions and require up-to-date records for improved service delivery. Typical use cases include modifying customer profiles, updating account statuses, and managing cross-channel engagement initiatives.

patch.summary: Update customer information in the workbench.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific customer in the cross-channel customer workbench using their unique identifier. Ensure that the provided information is accurate and complete to successfully apply the changes.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary information to update the customer workbench identified by CUST-100045. Ensure that all required fields are included and formatted correctly to facilitate the successful execution of the PATCH operation.
